Rivastigmine has also been tried in the treatment of vascular de- mentia. A systematic review9 concluded that although there is some evidence of benefit in these patients, available data are in- adequate and further trials were warranted before rivastigmine could be recommended. For the use of rivastigmine in the treatment of dementia in Par- kinson’s disease, see below. 1. Anand R, et al.
